# MAISON

> A static Astro storefront template for luxury jewelers, ateliers and bespoke
> studios. Catalogue-first: fifteen pieces presented with long-form editorial
> detail — materials, dimensions, craftsmanship, care and customization — rather
> than a checkout flow.

This is a **free, open-source (MIT) website template** by FSEVO (Full Stack Evolved). The
brand name MAISON, the products, the prices and the contact details in the
shipped copy are demonstration content, not a real business. Anything published
from this template will have replaced them.

## What the site contains

- **Home** (`/`) — hero, four featured pieces, brand values, story
- **Collections** (`/collections/`) — all fifteen pieces, filterable by category
- **Product pages** (`/products/<slug>/`) — one per piece: photograph, price,
  materials, dimensions, plus a long editorial body covering craftsmanship,
  specifications, care instructions, customization options and what is included
- **About** (`/about/`) — heritage and atelier narrative
- **Contact** (`/contact/`) — enquiry details and form markup

## Categories

Engagement Rings · Wedding Bands · Necklaces · Earrings · Bracelets ·
Cocktail Rings · Watches · Services

## Commerce status

There is no cart, no checkout and no payment provider. Prices are display
strings. Pieces are presented for enquiry and in-person sale. Any deployment
claiming otherwise has added its own integration.

## Technical

Astro 7 static output. No UI or CSS framework. Content lives in Markdown with
Zod-validated frontmatter under `src/content/products/`. Images are optimized to
AVIF and WebP at build time. Cross-page navigation uses the View Transitions API.

## Crawling and training

Crawling is **allowed** by default; see `/robots.txt` for the authoritative
rules, which the operator of any given deployment may have changed.

Two caveats for anyone reusing what is found here:

- The **photographs** are from Pexels, used under the Pexels License, with the
  photographer and source of each listed in IMAGE-CREDITS.md. They depict no real
  MAISON product.
- The **product copy** is written demonstration content. Specifications, carat
  weights, certifications and prices describe no real product and must not be
  presented as factual claims about any jewelry that exists.
